ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (outer lobes) to low-intensity dark pixels (central and peduncle regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the lateral segments of both lobes. A dark, low-intensity region is centered at the peduncle and tapers into the medial portions of each lobe. Significant pixel-level mottling (dark spots on white) is present across the high-intensity areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 40 degrees and a vertical pixel depth equivalent to 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude oscillations (2-5 pixels) and occasional deep notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins of both lobes, terminating in acute-angled lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the high-intensity white surfaces, consistent with focal mottling or scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far right distal tip (viewer perspective), accompanied by yellowish pixel clusters.
